$comment: GaoHe match-key test vectors (spec §6.1-3). matchKey: strip Cf + variation selectors, NFKC, strip whitespace, map quotes to ", dash runs to -, ellipsis runs to U+2026. splitParagraphs: split on line breaks, trim, drop empty keys, merge keys < 20 code points into the next paragraph (trailing remainder into the previous one).

matchKey.name: ideographic full stop and enumeration comma kept
single curly quotes, low-9 and reversed quotes
ASCII apostrophe and full-width quotation mark
ditto mark 〃 and double prime ″ are NOT quotes (″ becomes ′′ via NFKC)
double em dash —— collapses to one -
two-em dash ⸺ and three-em dash ⸻ (single characters used for ——)
two-em dash next to em dashes collapses to one -
horizontal bar, hyphen, non-breaking hyphen, figure dash, minus sign
full-width hyphen-minus and small em dash via NFKC
katakana prolonged sound mark ー is NOT a dash
half-width katakana ｺｰﾋｰ → full-width via NFKC
CJK 一 is NOT a dash
repeated ideographic full stop not mapped
zero-width char between base and combining mark does not block composition
CJK extension B kept as one code point
NFKC CJK compatibility ideograph U+F900 → 豈
mixed whitespace: space, tab, NBSP, ideographic space, thin space, NNBSP
matchKey.input: a	b c　d e f
